validate.title: Validation pack
validate.intro: Runs a fixed test set to check calculations, extraction and language parity.
validate.aiUnavailable: AI not configured on this server. Calculation checks still run offline.
validate.offline: You are offline. Connect to the internet to run AI checks.
validate.calcRule: 19 hand-computed RBI cases. Runs on this device, no network needed.
validate.extractionRule: 10 sample land records. Pass: area within 2%, owner name close match, survey numbers exact, Aadhaar last 4 exact.
validate.parityRule: One crop plan spoken in 6 languages. Pass: same crops and seasons, each area within 0.05 ha.
validate.openIntro: Points where the rule text allows more than one reading. Saakh uses the reading below until the bank confirms.
validate.saveFailed: Results shown but could not be saved on this device.
validate.description: Saakh is scored against a fixed, hand-checked test set: RBI limit arithmetic, land-record extraction from khasra images, and the same crop plan spoken in six languages.
validate.method.calc: Year 1 to 5 limits, term loan, KCC limit, eligibility and flags must match exactly.
validate.method.extraction: Area within 2%, owner name fuzzy, survey nos and Aadhaar last 4 exact.
validate.method.parity: Same crops and seasons in every language, each area within 0.05 ha.
validate.meta.calc: {count} hand-computed cases · runs on this device
validate.detail.calc: Each case is run through the live engine. Expected figures were computed by hand from the RBI KCC Directions 2026.
validate.detail.extraction: Expected fields for each sample record. Failed fields show what the model returned.
validate.openDesc: Where the Directions are ambiguous, Saakh records its interpretation.
validate.openFoot: These readings stay in force until the bank's credit policy confirms or overrides them. Each is covered by a calculation case above.
validate.methodCalc: Inputs and expected outputs are fixed in the validation set. The engine runs offline, so this score is recomputed on every page load.
validate.methodExtraction: Synthetic khasra images are sent to the same AI endpoint officers use. Owner names pass at 80% character similarity; other fields must match.
validate.methodParity: One crop plan, transcribed in six languages, is sent to the crop parser. Every language must return the same plan.
validate.methodFoot: AI results are stored on this device with the run time. If the AI service is not configured, those categories are marked unavailable rather than failed.

how.title: How Saakh works
how.principle: AI handles words. The engine handles numbers. The officer decides.
how.s1.title: Land record, read twice
how.s1.body: Photograph the khasra. Two independent readers extract owner, village, survey number, area and Aadhaar last 4. Where they disagree, the field is flagged for the officer to check against the paper.
how.s1.case: Opens Ramprasad Patel's case. Pick sample record 01 to see both reads agree.
how.s2.title: Crop plan by voice, in the farmer's language
how.s2.body: The farmer speaks the crop plan in their own language. Saakh transcribes it and maps each crop, season and area to the district Scale of Finance list.
how.s2.case: Play a sample clip in Hindi, Marathi, Gujarati, Telugu, Tamil or English.
how.s3.title: Officer confirms every figure
how.s3.body: Land, tenure, crops and areas are shown in an editable form. Nothing reaches the engine until the officer confirms it.
how.s3.case: Review the pre-filled details, then compute the limit.
how.s4.title: Appraisal agent
how.s4.body: The agent calls tools: the RBI KCC engine for the limit, risk rules (name, survey, area, double financing, SoF source), what-if scenarios, and up to 3 questions for the officer. 8 harness checks verify its report before you see it.
how.s4.case: Opens a suspicious case: the applicant is not the record owner and the land already backs an approved loan.
how.s5.title: Sanction note and farmer explanation
how.s5.body: A sanction note is drafted in the officer's language. A plain explanation of the limit is spoken to the farmer in theirs.
how.s5.case: Compute the limit first if the note step is not open yet.
how.s6.title: Officer decision and audit chain
how.s6.body: The officer approves, edits or rejects, with a reason for any change. Every step is written to a hash-chained audit log, so a later edit to any record is detectable.
how.s6.case: Opens an approved sample case and its audit chain.
